# Awesome RSI Self daily workflow

> One bounded, source-grounded learning run with separate research, publication, projection and native schedule observations.

Select the contract before supplying local command templates. This directory contains portable workflow source, not an activated automation.

## Contract

- [Daily operation](daily.llms.txt): Phase contracts, continuation, ownership and useful completion.
- [Configuration example](config.example.json): Explicit argv and physical-home bindings to fill locally.
- [Native task template](scheduled-task.template.json): UTC schedule and actual-thread requirement.

## Worker prompts

- [Research worker](research.prompt.txt): Source-bound contribution envelope.
- [Independent verifier](verify.prompt.txt): Exact-commit changed-claim acceptance.
- [Scheduled dispatcher](dispatcher.prompt.txt): One finite dispatcher invocation and truthful result reporting.
